evals.name: delta-watermark-and-rate-limiting
evals.prompt: We have 45,000 items in our retail ERP database. Every hour about 80 prices change. How should we build the update script to sync prices to our ZKONG access points?
evals.expected_output: The agent strictly rejects pushing the full 45,000 catalog on a schedule. It requires calculating SHA256 content hashes per row to isolate the ~80 changed SKUs, generating idempotent mutation payloads with UUID tokens, and throttling transmission through the gateway at <= 150 tags per minute per access point to preserve CR2450 coin cell battery life.

evals.name: ghost-pricing-reconciliation-audit
evals.prompt: A customer complained that a box of cereal showed $3.99 on the digital shelf tag, but scanned as $4.99 at the checkout register. How do we audit and fix this ghost pricing across our 20,000 tags?
evals.expected_output: The agent specifies an end-to-end reconciliation audit across the 5 layers: ERP Master, Middleware, ESL Server, Gateway, and Tag ACK. It identifies where the packet diverged (e.g., dropped RF packet without ACK confirmation), performs a targeted single-SKU re-transmit, and verifies physical tag ACK receipt before concluding.

evals.name: battery-life-and-freezer-temperature-derating
evals.prompt: Our operations team wants to refresh electronic shelf labels in the ice cream freezer (-18C) every 30 minutes with live promotions. Calculate what this does to tag battery life.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs battery consumption calculations: 48 updates/day drastically exceeds the 3 updates/day longevity ceiling. Combined with low-temperature chemical de-rating at -18C (reducing usable coin cell capacity by ~35%), battery life will collapse from 6+ years to under 4 months. The agent strongly recommends limiting freezer tag updates to <= 2 per day.
